# API reference

<!-- GENERATED by `fire docs` from server/*.go — do not edit by hand. -->

The server listens on `127.0.0.1:17490`. Every path starts with `/api/v1`. Writes (`POST`) need the header `X-Requested-With: fire`; only `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` are accepted as Host. There is one local learner and no accounts.

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/attempts` | Start a task {"kind": "lesson"\|"review"\|"quiz", "code"}; returns the lesson and the first question without its answer. |
| POST | `/api/v1/attempts/{id}/answer` | Answer {"choice": n}; returns correctness, explanation and the next question or the result with implicit credit. |
| GET | `/api/v1/edges` | Every link as {from, code, key, encompassing, kind}; ?kind=prerequisite\|implicit. |
| GET | `/api/v1/graph` | Every idea as a graph node: [{code, name, pack, topic, topic_name}]; edges come from /edges. |
| GET | `/api/v1/history` | The last 40 finished tasks. |
| GET | `/api/v1/ideas` | Search ideas: ?q= text, ?pack=, ?limit= (≤200), ?offset=. |
| GET | `/api/v1/ideas/{code...}` | One idea: lesson, questions with answers, links both ways. |
| GET | `/api/v1/info` | Loaded packs and how many ideas each has. |
| GET | `/api/v1/me` | Progress on a track (?track=all\|<pack>): learned, due, XP by day, memory of each idea, forecast. |
| GET | `/api/v1/names` | Every idea code with its title: {code: name}. |
| GET | `/api/v1/next` | The FIRe feed for a track: up to 8 tasks {kind, code, title, xp, covers}. |
| GET | `/api/v1/packs` | Every pack folder with its status, errors and warnings. |
| GET | `/api/v1/pin` | The current goal, if any: {pin: {code, kind, title, left, next} \| null}. |
| POST | `/api/v1/pin` | Set a goal {"code": idea or topic code}; an empty code clears it. The next lesson on the way to it leads the feed. |
| POST | `/api/v1/placement` | Start the placement test on ?track=. |
| POST | `/api/v1/placement/answer` | Answer a placement question {"choice": n}, −1 is "don't know". |
| GET | `/api/v1/plan` | Every lesson of a track in teaching order with its state: learned, due, available, partial or locked (and what it waits for). |
| GET | `/api/v1/program/{pack}` | One pack as a tree: section → topics → idea codes, plus a short card per idea. |
| GET | `/api/v1/progress/export` | Download all progress as JSON (format fire-progress-v1). |
| POST | `/api/v1/progress/import` | Replace all progress with an export (the request body). |
| POST | `/api/v1/progress/reset` | Forget all progress; needs {"confirm": "reset"}. |
